history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A vibrant, whimsical illustration in a sketchbook style, featuring a central, realistic portrayal of a young East Asian woman with long, flowing black hair and a soft smile. She wears an off-the-shoulder navy blue top and a short black skirt. The background is a page from a notebook, textured and slightly yellowed, adorned with various hand-drawn elements. To the left of the central figure, there are two sketched figures of the same woman in different poses and outfits, one in a light-colored off-the-shoulder dress, and another in a similar off-the-shoulder top and skirt. Scattered around these figures are colorful doodles: stars in yellow, pink, and blue; pink hearts; a rainbow with fluffy white clouds; and two small, chibi-style illustrations of a girl in a school uniform, one with a balloon and another resting her chin on her hand. Below the central figure and to the left, there's a sketch of the woman again, this time with her hair down, looking thoughtful. On the right side, near the chibi figures, are more scattered stars and a pink ice cream cone. In the lower section of the notebook page, there's a drawing of a planet with rings. Handwritten text in a playful, cursive font is scattered throughout the page, with some phrases visible like "Ewe im youy," "love you a dre fout yosen!", "pont murder!", "Hulhe!", "Sheik + heron", and "Aork. love at y yunde a. the vule this wid! then forward". The overall color palette is soft and pastel, with pops of brighter colors from the doodles. The lighting appears to be bright and even, as if illuminated by natural daylight, creating a cheerful and dreamy mood. The style blends realistic drawing with charming, cartoony elements, reminiscent of a personal journal or scrapbook.
